name: Kroger Delta Distribution Center Memphis TN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Driver reviews confirm gated, appointment-only entry; chain-link perimeter fence visible in Street View around the parking/yard; controlled truck entry off Bledsoe Rd.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Web reviews explicitly describe checking in at a guard shack after staging; booth not isolated in overhead imagery (likely at the yard pinch-point near building junction). Confidence high on existence, medium on exact location.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Street View (Mar 2025) shows tractor-trailers (J.B. Hunt 360box and others) queued/parked along Bledsoe Rd before the entrance; reviews say park first, then check in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large central paved yard between the drop rows and the dock face provides interior holding before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and abundant paved width at the yard entry; room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock bank on the south building's north face (30+ visible in one z19 segment) plus additional dock faces on the L-wing; total well into 50+ band, estimated ~110.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Massive NW drop yard with hundreds of trailers in parallel angled rows, plus a second drop row along the Bledsoe (east) frontage; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on more than one building face (south E-W wing and the NW-SE wing), suggesting separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Memphis metro industrial fabric (Holmes/Bledsoe Rd corridor), surrounded by other large warehouses; Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Kroger DC is the central L-shaped complex; a second large building sits just south but appears to be a separate (non-Kroger) tenant. Counted 2 conservatively.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale pad resolved in imagery; left false (listed uncertain).
fieldNotes.trailerCounts: Honest overhead estimates; drop yard is very dense.
